respuesta.pregunta: In payment-promise-gateway 0.0.10-test-crc-migration, can I send CREDIT_CARD as the paymentMethod when creating a payment promise with POST /payment_promise, or is that not one of the accepted methods?
respuesta.respuesta: The documentation for this version contradicts itself here. The curl example for POST /payment_promise sends `"paymentMethod": "CREDIT_CARD"` in the request body [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L351-L351]. However, GET /payment_promise/form is described as the endpoint for querying the available payment methods [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L121-L121], and its example response lists only CASH, DEBIT and ACCOUNT_MONEY in `payment_methods`. CREDIT_CARD is not among them [payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L392-L408]. From this documentation alone I can't confirm whether CREDIT_CARD is accepted. A practical check is to call GET /payment_promise/form for your user and site and see which methods it returns.
answer_checks: Calls the tool with software payment-promise-gateway and version 0.0.10-test-crc-migration.
Cites the POST /payment_promise example that uses CREDIT_CARD as paymentMethod.
Cites the GET /payment_promise/form example response listing only CASH, DEBIT and ACCOUNT_MONEY.
Explains the discrepancy without stating as fact that CREDIT_CARD is or is not accepted.
Does not invent a list of accepted payment methods beyond what the documents show.
